name: Priya Sharma
text: Khubsurat freshness, darun quality! Fish was spotless and delivered in 25 minutes. Best in Siliguri!

name: Rahul Mukherjee
text: Fatafati packing, on time. The chicken was farm-fresh, not frozen. Valo!

name: Vikram Chettri
text: Ekdom fresh. Best fish delivery in Siliguri! The Rohu was perfectly cleaned.

name: Sneha Pradhan
text: Nice and fresh. Simple ordering, fast delivery. Very happy!

name: Anjali Das
text: Darun sweet prawns! Great job - arrived still cold in the insulated bag.

name: Amit Bose
text: Best online fish service in town. Prawns were large and fresh. Nice!

name: Ritika Gurung
text: Valo quality. Very satisfied with the mutton. Will order again!

name: Subham Roy
text: Ordered Hilsa - absolutely fresh, like morning market. Delivery boy was polite too.

name: Deepa Thapa
text: Mutton was tender and clean. Got it in 20 minutes. Amazing service for Siliguri!

name: Arjun Ghosh
text: Fresh vegetables daily! Stopped going to the market. Siliguri Fresh Mart is a lifesaver.
